component.name: MedScript OPD
component.summary: Offline-first outpatient prescription and electronic medical records system

description.p: MedScript OPD is a private, offline-first Electronic Medical Records (EMR) and Prescription Management System purpose-built for independent practitioners, outpatient clinics, and polyclinics.

ul.li: Rapid Prescription Writing: Brand names in bold with generic composition below, dosage form prefixes (Tab., Cap., Inj., Syr.), and fast Enter-key keyboard navigation.
Comprehensive Diagnostic Library: 13 diagnostic lab panels and 48+ clinical tests with 1-click package selection.
Patient Vitals & Morbidity Tracking: Blood pressure, pulse, SpO2, and Celsius temperature trends with visual health alerts.
Professional PDF Letterheads: Multi-page vector printing with clinic branding, registration numbers, and digital Rx header.
Data Privacy & Security: Local SQLite storage with WAL durability, brute-force PIN protection, inactivity screen auto-lock, and immutable clinical audit trail.
Disaster Recovery: One-click database snapshots and automated scheduled backups.

description.p: Initial stable open-source release of MedScript OPD with enhanced clinical security, diagnostic libraries, and PDF letterheads.
